title: Equality & Hashing
prompt:
Implement value equality and hashability for a custom coordinate class.

Starting code:

class Coord:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x, self.y = x, y
    
    def ___(self, other):
        return (self.x, self.y) == (other.x, other.y)
        
    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((self.x, self.y))

title: Total Ordering Decorator
prompt:
Auto-generate all comparison methods from eq and lt using functools.

Starting code:

from functools import ___

@total_ordering
class Version:
    def __init__(self, major, minor):
        self.major, self.minor = major, minor
    def __eq__(self, other):
        return (self.major, self.minor) == (other.major, other.minor)
    def __lt__(self, other):
        return (self.major, self.minor) < (other.major, other.minor)
